title: George in the Library
subject: listening

paragraphs.text: Loads of people have phoned you.
NINA: I felt just like your secretary!
I went into the library this afternoon to have a look at a newspaper and I came across something really interesting.
GEORGE: No, a brochure from a summer festival - mainly Spanish music.
They had a video with all the highlights of the festival at a stand in the lobby to the library, so I heard them.
They play fantastic instruments - drums and flutes and old kinds of guitars.
I've never heard anything like it before.
GEORGE: The only problem is there aren't any cheap seats ...
NINA: Well, in that case we could sit right at the front - we'd have a really good view.
GEORGE: Yeah, though I think that if you sit at the back you can actually hear the whole thing better.
Anyway we can decide when we get there.
NINA: So will you All in the form or shall I?
Do you remember our new postcode?
NINA: Just a minute - I've got it written down here.
Do you need the phone too?
So, let's book two tickets for Guitarrini.
If you're sure £7.50 each is all right.
How do you feel about the singer?
But I've noticed something on the booking form that might just persuade me!
Singer, ticket £6. 00 includes drinks in the garden.
GEORGE: Sounds like a bargain to me!
NINA: Yes, let's book two tickets for that.
How about the pianist on the 22nd of June?
I've just remembered that's my evening class night.
I'll just have to go on my own - but we can go to the Spanish dance and guitar concert together, can't we?
GEORGE: Yes - I'm sure Tom and Kieran would enjoy that too.
I can see we're going to have to go without food for the rest of the week - we'll need to book four!
NINA: Wish we were students - look!
Children, Students and Senior Citizens get a 50% discount on everything.
NINA:是呢我都觉得自己像你的秘书了!
我下午去了图书馆看看报纸然后看见一些非常有意思的东西。
GEORGE:不是呢，是一本关于盛夏节日的小册子一主要是西班牙音乐。
所以这个叫做Guitarrini的乐团怎么样?
在图书馆大厅的一个站台那边，有他们乐团的视频，所有节日精彩部分都有呈现，所以我听到了他们的声音。
他们玩的乐器都好神奇一一鼓和长笛还有各种旧款吉他。
我从来没有听过想他们一样的音乐。
GEORGE:只有一个问题那就是没有便宜的票子…都是一个价钱。
NINA:好的，那这样的话我们可以坐在最前面，我们可以看的清楚点。
GEORGE:是的，虽然我认为坐在后面的话
其实可以听得更加清楚。
NINA:所以是你填表格，还是我填表格?
你记得我们新的邮政编码嘛?
NINA:等一下哦，我以前写下来过的。
所以，让我们买两张Guitarrini乐团的票子吧。
如果你确定每张票￡7．50是可以的话。
但是我刚注意到预定表格上有些东西让我很想去!
歌手，票价￡6．00包括花园里的饮料。
NINA:好。那我们就订两张票子吧。
要不要去看一下六月22日钢琴家弹奏钢琴?
我刚刚想起来我那天晚上有晚课。
那我就自己去了，但是我们可以一起去西班牙舞蹈和吉他音乐会对吧?
GEORGE:是的呢——而且我确定Tom和Kieran也会喜欢的
我觉得买了票以后，这个礼拜就没钱吃东西了——我们要买四张票!
NINA:真希望我们是学生啊——看!
小孩，学生和老人可以打五折。
GEORGE:如果我们是学生就好了!

questions.explanation: 本题在原文中有迷惑信息，Nina说坐在前面，而George则建议坐在后面，这样听音乐时效果会更好。
